create_webrtc_stream: create a WebRTC stream using the make_webrtc_stream function from actionengine
configure_turn_server: configure a TurnServer instance with relay credentials for WebRTC connectivity
configure_rtc_config: configure an RtcConfig instance with ICE server settings for WebRTC
start_webrtc_server: start a WebRtcServer instance to handle incoming WebRTC peer connections
